title: SpeakerResultV2
description: Raw speaker diarization evidence returned by the model host.

SpeakerInferenceEvidenceV2.description:
Raw evidence returned by one speaker-inference backend.

The three variants make backend provenance structural. In particular, a
local backend cannot construct a pyannoteAI result without also supplying
the completed provider job evidence, and cloud evidence cannot masquerade
as a normalized-only local segment list.

oneOf.description: Complete successful pyannoteAI job output, before normalization.

job_id.description: Provider job which produced the output.

warning.description: Optional provider warning returned with the successful job.

oneOf.description: Normalized segments from the local pyannote runtime.
Normalized segments from the local NeMo runtime.

SpeakerProviderJobIdV2.description: Provider job identifier attached to durable raw speaker evidence.

SpeakerSegmentV2.description:
One raw speaker diarization segment returned by Python.

On the wire `{"start_ms", "end_ms", "speaker"}`; the two bounds are one
[`AdmittedInterval`], admitted when the segment is read, so an inverted,
negative or out-of-range segment is refused at the boundary and no
consumer checks the order again.

end_ms.description: The end, in milliseconds; never before the start.

speaker.description: Stable speaker label chosen by the model adapter.

start_ms.description: The start, in milliseconds from the start of the media.
